rescore_lock.summary_pair_scope: cross-acquisition-minute block AND nondegenerate baseline >0.06m; pair rows retain all pairs
rescore_lock.summary_point_aggregation: pool every footprint-XY-inside cached DLT survivor across eligible pairs; do not take median pair count

ground.source: elevation samples: observed SfM plus dense-init points only; spatial target/exclusion masks: supplied footprints_aoi footprint geometry
ground.fallback: median of finite cell q10 values after Tukey 1.5-IQR clipping

coverage.occupied_definition: footprint-intersecting XY cell containing at least one cached DLT point

numeric_boundary_classes.i_seed_usable: n>=20 AND median_abs_dz<=1.0m AND fitted_plane_to_lod2_rms<=1.0m AND ransac_inlier_ratio>=0.50 AND grid_coverage>=0.25
numeric_boundary_classes.ii_near_height_scattered_or_low_coverage: median_abs_dz<=1.5m but class i is false
numeric_boundary_classes.ambiguous_registration: registration_class=ambiguous; score reported as untrusted and boundary class withheld
